source_sha_policy: Production must serve the reviewed immutable homepage and viral archive source, preserve route and metadata receipts, and expose no unsupported metrics.

data_contract.policy: Evidence before amplification; every metric requires a dated snapshot; duplicate URLs collapse at runtime; private, minor, legal, financial and quarantined records are excluded from the public universe.

release_intent: Make Igor visibly present across the homepage, surface verified viral moments with source and date boundaries, and add a dedicated public response archive without inventing engagement metrics.
promotion_gate: The release is accepted only when 7ya.io serves build marker igor-hero-viral-sections-20260718-1, the homepage exposes the verified viral section, /viral/ is indexable and filterable, critical routes pass, and robots.txt plus sitemap.xml return successfully.
